caption:
Your birth details never leave your phone or computer when creating your Janam Kundali.

When exploring a rishta, keeping sensitive information private is essential. RishtaPatra offers three products: biodata maker, Rishta Connect (matchmaking), and Janam Kundali (free).

With our client-side astrology engine running entirely in your browser, no request carries your birth data anywhere else. Calculations are indicative; consult your pandit.

Visit rishtapatra.com to compute your kundali safely on your device.
